workup.reason_code_summary: The issuer says the cardholder did not authorise this £87.40 card-not-present digital purchase, had the card in their possession, and has no relationship with QuickStream Digital. To defend under Mastercard 4837, the merchant must satisfy any two of four requirements: a full AVS match plus a CVV match, successful 3DS authentication, two prior undisputed transactions with matching billing details in the past 12 months, or signed proof of delivery to the billing address.

requirements.reasoning: The transaction record shows AVS result N and CVV result N, so both checks failed on the disputed transaction. No merchant document can override these pre-check facts.
The transaction record shows 3DS status 'not_attempted', so no Identity Check authentication took place.

No prior transaction history was supplied. The merchant's own report lists 'Customer account age New (first transaction)', which indicates there were no prior undisputed transactions with this cardholder.
This is a digital goods or service transaction (MCC 5815) with no shipping address on file, so there was no physical delivery to prove with a signature.

workup.action_justification: AVS/CVV failed and 3DS was not attempted, and both are fixed facts of record; the account was a first-time customer, so no combination of two requirements can be met.
workup.rationale: The disputed transaction txn_7762GH failed both AVS (N) and CVV (N) and was processed without 3DS authentication, so requirements 1 and 2 cannot be met. The merchant's internal fraud report records the customer as new, making this their first transaction, so the prior-transaction requirement cannot be met either. Signed proof of delivery does not apply to this digital purchase. The only evidence supplied is the merchant's internal risk score and its own conclusion, which is not compelling evidence under 4837. Liability is accepted.
caveats: The internal fraud report was generated on 12 May 2025, after the chargeback of 11 May 2025. It reflects the merchant's own assessment and is not independent evidence.
The low risk score is based only on amount, MCC and time of day. It ignores the failed AVS/CVV, the new, unseen device fingerprint (fp_new_unseen) and the new customer account.

The transaction took place at 03:42 UTC from IP 45.227.255.103. Geolocation of this IP was not verified against the GB-issued card; the analyst may wish to check it, though it would not change the outcome.

rule_text:
Mastercard 4837 - No Cardholder Authorisation
Issuer claim: Cardholder denies authorising the transaction (card-not-present fraud equivalent).
Logic: Any TWO of the 4 requirements must be satisfied.
Compelling evidence requirements:
  1. AVS match (full address) AND CVV match on the disputed transaction
  2. 3D Secure authentication completed successfully (Mastercard SecureCode / Identity Check)
  3. Two prior undisputed transactions from the same cardholder with this merchant in the past 12 months, with matching billing details
  4. Proof of delivery to the cardholder's billing address with signature
prechecks: AVS: N (no match); CVV: N (no match); 3DS: not_attempted
Shipping vs billing postcode: no shipping postcode on file (digital goods or service)
Chargeback raised 12 days after the transaction
Flag: both AVS and CVV failed on the disputed transaction
